items.title: Classify the five proof admissibility convergence gaps
items.context: Confirm which gaps are annotation-only versus missing implementation before changing code. The five gaps are supportedSchemaVersion, verifierVersionSupported, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version.

items.title: Implement verifier version admissibility support
items.context: Add a real supported-verifier-version check equivalent to schema and contract support, with a deterministic reason code and tests for unsupported verifier versions.

items.title: Bind existing schema and contract checks to convergence requirements
items.context: Add code facts/annotations or registry mappings so gap_analyze can see that supportedSchemaVersion, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version are implemented without changing their existing behavior.

items.title: Verify high convergence gaps are closed
items.context: Run build, proof admissibility smokes, gap_analyze, and convergence_check to prove the five high gaps are closed without expanding scope.
